Title: Anil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Anil - 34 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Hema - 27 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Kavita - 63 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Meenakshi - 31 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
5. Nitin - 30 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The mall - a row of shops, an escalator
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
4. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The mall - Day

[Anil stands in the mall. Kavita and Hema stand near him.]

Hema: "Let's do something fun today."

[Anil tries on a new jacket.]

Kavita: "Hema, listen!"

[Anil pays at the counter.]

Anil (laughing): "How beautiful!"

[Anil carries the shopping bags out.]

Kavita: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

Anil: "Let's begin."

[Anil wraps a bandage around his bleeding hand.]

Anil: "Really?"

[Anil plays dead to fool his sister.]

Anil: "That's great!"

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

[Hema stands in the kitchen. Anil, Kavita and Meenakshi stand near her.]

Kavita: "Let's begin."

[Hema rolls out rotis on the board.]

Hema: "This is amazing!"

[The knife slips and Anil's hand is cut; blood drips onto the floor.]

Hema: "One more time!"

[Anil winces as blood trickles from the cut on his thumb.]

Anil: "Show me too!"

Scene 4: The road - Day

Anil: "So, here we are!"

[Anil rides his motorbike to the market.]

Anil: "Mom, look at this."

[Anil starts his scooter and rides off.]

Meenakshi: "Show me too!"

[Anil drives the car to the office.]

Hema (laughing): "That was fun!"

[Anil rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Meenakshi: "That's easy."

[The thug's knife wounds Anil in the stomach; he doubles over.]

Anil: "Really?"

[Anil withdraws cash from the ATM.]

Anil: "Yes, of course."

[Anil wades through the knee-deep water.]

Hema: "I really enjoyed today."
